title: Asking the way
description: Ask how to get somewhere and understand simple directions.

blocks.text: To ask the way, say Przepraszam, jak dojść do… followed by the place. After do, the place is in the genitive case: dworzec becomes do dworca, poczta becomes do poczty, and centrum stays do centrum. The answers use a few simple words: prosto (straight on), w lewo (left), w prawo (right), blisko (near) and daleko (far).

blocks.translation: Excuse me, how do I get to the station?

blocks.note: Proszę followed by an infinitive is a polite instruction.

lines.speaker: Turysta
lines.translation: Excuse me, how do I get to the post office?

lines.speaker: Pani Ewa
lines.text: Proszę iść prosto, a potem w prawo.
lines.translation: Go straight on, and then right.

lines.speaker: Pani Ewa
lines.translation: No, it is near. Five minutes.
